name: clawopt
description: ClawOPT · OpenClaw 全功能 Web 客户端 + 可一键装配的角色预设库

scripts.dev: export BACKEND_PORT=3100 FRONTEND_PORT=3105 CLAWOPT_DATA_DIR=.clawopt_dev && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.release: export BACKEND_PORT=3110 FRONTEND_PORT=3115 CLAWOPT_DATA_DIR=.clawopt_release && npm run build && concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run version:meta && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run locales:check && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && PORT=3110 CLAWOPT_DATA_DIR=.clawopt_release npm start
